title: 加里奥·小鸟食台
description: 白金石像加里奥收拢双翼，小心托住小鸟食台，保留巨大护肩与雕像体形。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Galio is a massive pale stone sentinel with broad gold-trimmed armor-like plates, a pointed horned head, huge angular wings, and a heavy heroic chest silhouette. Preserve his carved petricite material and thick limbs, but round the crayon edges and give him kind attentive eyes. He is a living statue rather than a human in ordinary clothes, with his integrated stone surfaces intact.
art_direction.scene: He kneels beside a little garden tree and holds a tiny bird feeder steady in both enormous palms while a round sparrow investigates. His wings fold neatly behind his back and fit within the square. A simple hedge and warm morning sky make the scale contrast sweet, with no city destruction or battle scenery.
art_direction.palette: stone ivory, pale gold, dusty blue, leaf green
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
